name: Old Coldmouth
place: lies half-sunk in the mere below Coldwater like an upturned boat; the water around it never warms
_doc: Stream E (M2). A huge cold-blooded thing from the bottom of the mere. Its breath is a long freezing cone, it slams the ice so shards fall in scattered circles, and at half health the mere freezes: soak the cracking-ice circles or everyone goes through.

party.solo: Hard solo: two soaks and only one of you (one fails every time).
party.m5: M5 drops to one crack for a solo player.

pull: The water around your boots goes very cold, very fast.
say.death: Old Coldmouth sinks back into the mere. The water warms, slowly.
say.reset: Old Coldmouth settles back into the mud.

breath.name: Freezing Breath
breath.say: Old Coldmouth draws a long breath — get out of the line of its mouth!

cracking.name: Cracking Ice
cracking.say: The ice cracks in two places — someone stand on each crack!

telegraphs.failSay: The ice gives way under everyone!

phases.name: Frozen Mere
phases.say: The whole mere freezes with a crack like thunder!
